thread:
Maya: Heads-up  running a 30m 'battle drill' tomorrow 10:00 PT to finalize the competitive playbook for the launch. Goals: 2 defensible benchmark callouts, 3 SDR hooks, and a one-slide rebut map vs cloud vendors / managed LLM APIs / infra vendors. Who can join? :crossed_swords:
Ethan: I'm in. I'll bring the micro-bench numbers (256/512 token runs) and a short note on routing fallbacks.
Nina: In. Uploading P50/P95 charts and a CSV of canary runs for quantized configs.
Sam: I'll sketch the rebut map  format: objection + one-line response + two supporting datapoints.
Kai: SDR hooks should be <18 words. Propose PLG, AE, and Tech slices.
Maya: Draft hooks to iterate:
  PLG: "Lower token spend, keep chat latency predictable across hosted, dedicated, and private."
  AE: "SLA-backed inference + private deployment options for regulated workloads."
  Tech: "Intelligent batching + KV caching + quant-friendly kernels = lower unit cost without latency tradeoffs."
Ethan: Bench language: avoid absolutes. Recommend: "In our benchmark, up to 3-4x lower unit cost under typical chat workloads; see appendix."
Nina: FYI staging medians at 512: Redwood ~24ms, CloudY ~120ms on similar hardware. Cost depends on quant & batching; attaching raw logs.
Sam: Common objections list: "We already run CloudY", "We need guaranteed SLA", "We can't manage private infra". I'll pair each with rebut + data.
Kai: Example short rebut to "We already run CloudY": "They offer scale; we deliver predictable latency and lower token-level spend via runtime-level batching and cache, with a migration path to dedicated/private."
Maya: Inbound routing rule suggestion: if demo request contains latency|SLA|private|dedicated|throughput|predictable -> tag enterprise-sales; else growth-inbound. SD-ops to implement.
sd-ops-bot: Reminder: calendar invite created for 10:00-10:30 PT and pre-read uploaded to the marketing drive.
Ethan: Action items: Nina -> bench appendix + CSVs; Sam -> rebut slide; Kai -> 3 SDR hooks + A/B variants; Maya -> stitch pre-read and run the drill.
Nina: Uploading charts now. Added short explainer on quant tradeoffs and a table of observed unit-cost deltas.
Maya: Keep claim language conservative, link to appendix. We'll finalize snippets post-drill and hand off a one-pager to SDRs by Friday. :thumbsup:
Kai: For SDR playtest, propose 60-email micro-A/B (PLG vs Tech) with a 72h response window. Capture whether they mention SLA/latency in replies.
Maya: Great. See you all tomorrow. Add anything else to the pre-read.
